title: Lean LFM-to-Dirac Derivation
description: Noncanonical Lean 4 research derivation through DIRAC-015. Starting from a positive two-field C19 action, the artifact derives a massive C19 Klein-Gordon tangent, proves that a cubical four-component Dirac Hamiltonian squares to its continuum symbol, controls lattice and centered-time corrections, and derives the positive-frequency density/current limit from the same action and embeddings. The complete chain passes an adversarial audit and deterministic clean-checkout reproduction. A localized physical electron, electromagnetic coupling, and uniqueness remain open.
